lines: 辛苦了！这里是宝可梦中心。在这里\n可以回复宝可梦的体力。要让您的宝{be01}\n可梦休息一下吗？
久等了！交给我的宝可梦们全都变得\n精力充沛了哦！
I daresay a Trainer isn’t qualified if\nPokémon aren’t settled and friendly.{be00}\nHave you given them any Pokéblocks?
Let me hazard a guess why you’re in\nVerdanturf. The reason: Contests.{be01}\nAll Contest challenges originate here.
{0100:0} took a closer look at the\nHoenn region map.
